⭐ WOF MENU ENGINEERING MATRIX (PROFITABILITY VS. POPULARITY)

Classifies current menu items into 4 strategic restaurant quadrants based on Contribution Margin (Profit) and Sales Volume.

⭐ STARS (High Profit, High Volume) PRIORITY
Top performers! Protect recipe consistency, maintain quality, and feature prominently.
🐎 PLOWHORSES (Low Profit, High Volume) OPTIMIZE
High volume staples with thin margins. Modestly increase price or optimize recipe portions.
🧩 PUZZLES (High Profit, Low Volume) PROMOTE
High profit margin but under-ordered. Feature in delivery runs, social promos, and combo meals.
🐶 DOGS (Low Profit, Low Volume) RE-ENGINEER
Low profit and low popularity. Re-engineer ingredients or replace with a new seasonal item.
